data.name: Safoor
data.gender_notes: Safoor is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Originated from the Arabic word ‘SAFAR’ which means to travel, Safoor is a name given to the one who is soft, delicate and gentle. It is also a name given to someone who is kind and compassionate. The name Safoor carries the meaning “Soft, Delicate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Safoor usually hope their child will grow to embody soft, delicate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Safoor is a name that represents the softness and gentleness of nature, as well as the compassionate and kind-hearted nature of an individual. It is a name that encourages one to be gentle and compassionate towards others, and to find beauty and peace in the softness of nature and in the kindness of others.
data.etymology: Safoor belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Soft, Delicate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Safoor total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

As individuals seek comfort and security in a world full of challenges, the name can serve as an eternal reminder of God's tender mercy and compassion towards His creations. Ultimately, it serves as an embodiment of kindness and gentleness, both in daily life and in one's relationship with God.
